chunks.text:
Software Requirements Specification
Auto Run MRP
15th Apr 2026

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: The objective of this requirement is to automate the MRP (Material Requirement Planning) Run process to ensure timely and accurate generation of material requirements without manual intervention.

chunks.title: Process Flow
chunks.heading: Process Flow
chunks.text:
Step 1: BOM Selection during OC Creation via EDI Buyer PO
While creating the OC from the EDI Buyer PO, the system should handle BOM selection as follows:
• If multiple BOMs are available for the article, the system should allow the user to select the required BOM from the list.
• If only one BOM is available, the system should automatically attach the BOM in the EDI screen without requiring user selection.
• The system should display only those BOMs which are in Approved status for selection or auto-attachment.
• Only one BOM (Bill of Materials) should be allowed to be attached to a single Summary OC.
• In case of any revision in the OC, the system should automatically re-run the MRP to reflect the updated requirements.
In the above screen you can see BOM will be select while creating the OC.
Step 2: Auto MRP
MRP Scheduler Configuration (Backend Controlled)
• The MRP scheduler will be configured at the backend only, and no UI/screen will be provided to users for scheduler configuration.
• The system will automatically trigger MRP runs based on backend-defined schedules.
Error Handling and Monitoring for MRP Run
• In case of any error during MRP execution, the system should capture and log the error details.
• A separate screen should be provided for users to monitor MRP run errors.
• This screen should display:
• Article / OC reference
• MRP run date and time

chunks.title: Process Flow
chunks.heading: Process Flow
chunks.text:
• Execution status (Success/Failed)
• Detailed error messages
• Users should be able to analyse the errors and take corrective actions from this screen.
• The system should also allow users to reprocess/re-run MRP after resolving the issues.
• Additionally, users should have the provision to manually trigger MRP for specific articles/OCs in urgent scenarios, even before the scheduled run.
Requirement 2: MRP Percentage-Based Execution — Problem Statements for Team Discussion
Currently, the MRP screen runs for the full open quantity. The proposal is to introduce a percentage input at the MRP level so that a planner can trigger MRP for only a portion of the required quantity (e.g., entering 80% runs MRP only for 80% of the open/production quantity).
Case 1 — Incremental Percentage Run (80% → 90%)
A planner runs MRP at 80%, which generates planned orders for 80% of the required quantity. Later, the same planner (or another user) comes back and runs MRP again at 90% for the same items and the same period. The question is what happens to the already planned 10% gap — does the system treat the second run as a top-up for the remaining 10%, or does it re-trigger the full 90% afresh, causing duplication of the overlapping 80% already planned? How does the system distinguish between an incremental intent and a fresh override?
Case 2 — Percentage Decreased on Re-run (90% → 70%)

chunks.title: Process Flow
chunks.heading: Process Flow
chunks.text:
MRP has already been executed at 90%, creating planned orders for 90% of the quantity. Now the planner re-runs MRP at a lower percentage, say 70%. The question is whether the system should automatically cancel or reverse the previously planned orders for the excess 20%, or whether those orders remain open and create an overplanning situation. Who is responsible for cleaning up the delta, and does the system even flag this discrepancy?
Case 3 — Production Quantity Changes After Percentage-Based MRP Has Run
MRP was run at 80% based on a production quantity of, say, 310 units (as visible on the screen). Later, the production quantity itself gets revised downward — for example, from 310 to 200 units. The planned orders were already generated based on 80% of 310. The question is whether the percentage-based planned orders now become invalid or excessive, how the system reacts to this mismatch, and whether a re-run of MRP at the same 80% would automatically correct to 80% of the new 200, or retain the older planned quantities.
Requirement 3: MRP Auto MRP Percentage Configuration
The purpose of this requirement is to automate MRP execution based on predefined percentage configurations, so users do not need to enter percentages manually every time.
Objective:
A separate screen should be provided where users can define MRP percentages based on the below fields:
• Company

chunks.title: Process Flow
chunks.heading: Process Flow
chunks.text:
• Company Division
• Buyer
• Buyer Department
• Product Group
• Subcategory
Users should be able to enter and maintain MRP percentages against these combinations.
Example:
• Buyer = ABC Buyer
• Product Group = Knitwear
• Subcategory = T-Shirt
• MRP Percentage = 80%
System Behaviour:
• During scheduler-based MRP execution, the system should automatically pick the configured MRP percentage based on the matching configuration.
• The configured percentage should auto-update in the MRP screen.
• The scheduler should run MRP based on the configured percentage instead of full quantity.
• Users should be able to edit and maintain these percentage configurations from the new screen.
